title: cEDH simulation request v1
description: The POST /simulate envelope. Versioned in its own right because the previous boundary pinned only the RESPONSE: the request body was described in prose, each side built its own reading of it, and the two never matched on the wire while both test suites stayed green.

scenario.description: goldfish_assembly.v1 measures turn-to-assembly. goldfish_diagnostics.v1 runs the five bounded diagnostic probes (opening, development, commander_loss, creature_wipe, finish) and is refused unless the service has diagnostics enabled; it cannot be combined with sweep or a non-empty ablate, and is bounded independently of games' normal cap.

$comment: sweep: true and a non-empty ablate are mutually exclusive; the service returns 400 rather than silently preferring one. scenario: goldfish_diagnostics.v1 additionally refuses sweep/ablate with 400, and the service rejects it with 403 while diagnostics is disabled.
